collection.title: London Taxis International TX4 2006 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a London Taxis International TX4 2006 Onwards model which requires a 20" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 10" for the passengers side. This model uses the Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
